title: BMD-45 real CCTV (Bengaluru)
description: 44 real CCTV frames from Bengaluru Police Safe City cameras (BMD-45 validation split, 1920x1080 PNG, daytime 06:00-18:00, February 2025), 142.4 MB (142388382 bytes) in total. Vehicle-only ground truth: Hatchback/Sedan/SUV/MUV/Van/Tempo-traveller -> car, Bus/Mini-bus -> bus, Truck/LCV (light goods carrier) -> truck, Two-wheeler -> motorbike, Bicycle -> bicycle; Three-wheeler (auto-rickshaw) and Other are ignore regions. Two-wheeler and Bicycle boxes include the rider. There is no person ground truth, so only scored_labels are scored on this set. Resolution is uniform (res:fhd); the source has no per-image camera or timestamp metadata (file names are anonymised), so images are spread by seeded random sampling. Very distant vehicles are often unannotated.
attribution: BMD-45: Bengaluru Mobility Dataset, AI for Integrated Mobility (AIM) group, Indian Institute of Science (IISc), Bengaluru (Sharma, Mhatre, Gawali, Bokkasam, Kishore, Pattanaik, Rambha, Pinjari, Kovvali, Chakraborty, Rathore, Krishnapuram, Simmhan; CVPR Findings 2026).
